title: Youth commission list of county-funded youth programs
summary: As of the September 21 meeting, the commission was asking for a list of county-funded youth programs, and the chair hoped it would arrive before the next meeting so it could go out with the meeting packet. A speaker said the problem isn't necessarily a lack of resources but a lack of awareness.

timeline.text: The vice chair will add locations, ages and access points to the list of funded youth programs.
The vice chair shared a list of youth programs funded by the Department of Human Concerns.
The chair hopes the program list arrives before the next meeting so it can go out with the meeting packet.
